attributes.title: ACC.27 Together With WCC
attributes.summary:
ACC.27 is the American College of Cardiology's 2027 Annual Scientific Session, held jointly with the World Heart Federation's World Congress of Cardiology. It runs April 10 to 12, 2027, at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston, Texas.

There are in-person packages (standard and PLUS) and a virtual @Home option, with three price tiers for in-person registration: early bird until December 2, advance until February 24 and regular until April 12. The hotel block closes on Thursday, March 18, 2027. ACC has not yet published the number of CME credits on the pages we checked.
